title: Playing dances, pit and any trombone chair
summary: Asked about dance work, Henry says he learned to play everything and any trombone part.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: That's your wife. She's catching the back. I'm going to ask about the dance band work. If you ever played many dances or in any dance orchestra or just mostly brass bands.

I play anything, dance, jobs, sit down in the pit, any place where they're playing. Because when I learned how to play, I learned how to play everything just to be played, wherever the man wants you to play. Second, third, fourth trombone, anything on the trombone.
